nom: NATASHA DENONA Hy-Gen Energizing & Hydrating Primer Serum

avis.texte: After using this product, I look into the mirror and smile. It makes your skin looks so hydrated.

I absolutely love the Natasha Denona HY-GEN Energizing & Hydrating Primer Serum! The texture feels lightweight and smooth, and it absorbs beautifully into the skin without feeling heavy or sticky. It gives my skin a fresh, hydrated glow and creates a great base before applying makeup. My foundation applies more evenly and looks smoother throughout the day. A little goes a long way, so the bottle lasts longer than expected. Definitely a new favorite in my routine!

The one thing that I like the best about this is if you're not someone who wants to put on a heavy face of makeup, this can still make you look like you are glowing. There is pearlescent Shimmer inside and so it definitely makes you look like you're glowing and have some highlighter on. When it's hot in the summertime here in California a full face of makeup is not generally ideal, so this helps make your face look dewy and glowy even without a full face of makeup highly recommend. I received something in exchange for this post (free product, payment, sweeps entry)

This does hold makeup on for the entire day, but that glow is totally lost under it. I have tried different brands and products and it doesn't matter. You don't see any glow after putting anything on top of it.

First, I will say the smell was pleasant. The way it made my skin look luminous while also feeling hydrating was pleasant. My skin is normally both dry and oily. It didnt make my oily skin overly oily or feel as such either which was a huge plus for me. I loved using it and once I'm out, I will be purchasing more! I love that its a serum and a primer so it glides effortlessly with your make up. I blend it with my foundation and it goes on smoothly. No issues with my fine lines.
I was excited to try it, but I had a bad reaction to it. It turned my face red and itchy. I'm debating whether to attempt it again. If I do, I will update my review.
I tried this as both a serum and a primer. I love it both ways. I love how glowing it makes your skin when used alone. I received this is a free sample, but will definitely purchase when I run out!

This primer works really well on my skin! I feel like it is hydrating without being too heavy, and preps my skin really well for makeup. I also love that it reduces shine, as my skin can get kind of oily in the summertime.

the natasha denona hy-gen energizing & hydrating primer serum is a really nice prep step before makeup. it feels lightweight, absorbs quickly, and gives my skin a hydrated, refreshed look without feeling greasy. i like how it creates a smooth base for makeup application and helps my skin look a little more radiant throughout the day. while it didn't completely wow me, it definitely does a good job of adding hydration and making my makeup go on more evenly. overall, it's a solid product that works well in my routine.
very expensive for what it is: a rather sticky highlighter. Fine if you're going for a really glowy look.

I use this product every morning after washing my face and no longer use moisturizer. That's how hydrating this serum is. It's so thick and luminous. There's no scent and is very effective yet gentle on the skin. My skin looks radiant and more plump after using this product. It's amazing. I'm buying more when this bottle runs out. 100% recommend.

First, the product itself is gorgeous- it's this pretty iridescent serum. The consistency is great, not too heavy, not too light. I don't like feeling like I have a lot product on my skin and this feels nice. It absorbs well while still being lightly hydrating. Leave a nice dewey glow on my skin. My only minor complaint is the dropper bottle- the dropper doesn't always work well at pulling the product into it and i usually have to try a few times. Not a huge deal breaker.

avis.titre: I would repurchase at a different price point
avis.texte: This product left a nice glow and my skin feel hydrated however, I don't think I would've tried this product if I had to spend my own money due to the price.

I am absolutely delighted with the HY-GEN ORIGINAL Primer Serum. It creates a wonderfully smooth canvas for my makeup application. My foundation now glides on effortlessly and last significantly longer throughout the day. Furthermore, my son feels incredibly hydrated and supple after using it. This primer serum had truly become an essential step in my beauty routine. This primer serum offers a remarkable base for my foundation that resembles pearls. Don't delay, buy it.

I received Natasha Denona HY-GEN - Energizing & Hydrating Primer Serum for free in exchange for my honest review. I have been using this combo serum and primer for a few weeks now and have enjoyed it. I mostly use it as a serum in my skincare routine before applying moisturizer, but I often end up applying makeup afterwards during the daytime as well. The serum itself has an iridescent color. It's not too watery but not super thick either. It feels lightweight and silky on the skin, leaving a glowing, dewy finish. It does have a slight pleasant scent, though I would prefer no scent at all as someone with sometimes sensitive skin. However, at least I did not have any negative reactions to it. As far as performance, I found the serum to be hydrating and good for my skin barrier. I do feel like my face has looked calmer and more even toned since I've been using this, and that's while I was also on vacation in the sun and sweaty most days. And lastly, while I did not use it specifically as a primer, I thought my makeup applied well over it. Overall, I thought this was a good serum that I'd recommend.

I've been really enjoying the HY-GEN Energising & Hydrating Primer Serum. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly into the skin without feeling sticky. It gives my skin a healthy, hydrated glow and creates a smooth base for makeup application. My foundation applied more evenly and stayed fresh throughout the day. I also love that it feels nourishing while providing a radiant finish. A great addition to my daily makeup routine!
I honestly use this product by itself with no makeup. It makes my skin feels sooo wonderful and THE GLOWWW 🤩 buy it, I promise you it's worth it :)

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I am pretty amazed by this product. First of all, the texture is silky and lightweight. The primer feels hydrating on my skin, almost like skincare, while still doing its job as a makeup primer. It smooths and illuminates my skin and minimizes the appearance of pores. Don't expect the dramatic blurring effect that some heavy silicone-based primers provide. This isn't one of those products. I like that I don't need to use a moisturizer before applying it because most moisturizers make my makeup pill. I tested it for two weeks before writing this review, and it didn't cause any breakouts. Highly recommended!

I received this product from Natasha Denona in exchange for my honest review. The HY-GEN primer serum is a luxurious product with multiple uses. I've taken a couple weeks to try it as both a serum under moisturizer and as a primer under foundation. The product out of the dropper is a milky white opalescent color that applies smoothly to skin. As a serum, if gives a gorgeous glow to your skin. It's perfect for a day out on the beach when you don't want to wear a full face. As a primer, it helps keep your foundation on all day while giving a more subtle glow from within look. It is a must have if you want a healthy glow without any chunky glitter bits.
Took me by surprise on how amazing this product is! Super hydrating and seriously makes my skin look younger. Im hooked!!
I loved this primer made my make up look so dewy my skin looked so plumped and hydrated love it

The serum is nice. It has a nice texture and feels good on the skin. It is glowy, but it does feel hard to justify adding another product to the lineup. If I'm in the mood to do a more elaborate process then I'm using this for sure

avis.titre: Amazing serum that leaves my skin smooth and glowing
avis.texte: I've been using this serum daily after cleansing and before moisturizer. It absorbs quickly, feels lightweight, and doesn't leave my skin greasy or sticky. After a few weeks of use, my skin looks smoother, more hydrated, and has a healthy glow. I also noticed that my makeup applies more evenly. A little goes a long way, so the bottle lasts a while. Overall, I'm very happy with the results and would definitely purchase it again.

avis.titre: Made my makeup stay all day
avis.texte: I didn't believe in primer but I think I'll start using primer now

I do not routinely use primer, and if the lingering stickiness is an indication I doubt I would use primer other than very special occasions requiring full makeup. The luminous quality was appealing through and added a nice glow to everyday makeup, along with adding minutes to the getting-ready routine for the stickiness to settle down.

avis.titre: Has a perfume scent but does work
avis.texte: Overall I did like this primer. It does have a scent which Im not a fan of. However, it worked well as a primer and did dry out my skin.
This primer is ok , it gave me definitely radiance but it didn't really help my foundation last longer , the radiance is very subtle under make up , just a glow .
I loved this product helped me so much i highly recommend this

"This primer serum is a total game-changer. It is incredibly lightweight and sinks into the skin instantly, giving you a gorgeous, dewy 'glass skin' glow without feeling greasy at all. It keeps my skin feeling hydrated all day while perfectly balancing my oilier T-zone. My foundation applies like an absolute dream over it and stays fresh for hours. If you want a plump, radiant base that feels like high-end skincare, you need to try this!"

I have been using this product for a month now and it is beautiful on the skin. It provides a lovely glow to the skin that makes you look luminous. I have used this over and under my moisturizer and sunscreen and I find that it applies nicely both ways and works with all my other products but I prefer it under my moisturizer. This serum/primer is slightly heavy upon first application and I do find it needs a minute to soak into the skin before moving onto next steps. Once it soaks in I do not find it to be heavy or greasy though. I find it wears nicely all day under makeup. If you are looking for a natural glowy look and you want to get skincare benefits from your primer I think this product is for you. You glow girl! I received this product for free for review.

I've been using the Hy-Gen primer serum more as an under makeup primer. I apply the serum after my moisturizer and before my foundation. It has a beautiful pearlescent color and leaves skin so glowy. Because of this I would recommend using with a matte foundation.

I love the slight shimmer you see when it's in the tube. It's very easy to use and I feel like my face has been looking more hydrated and less dry. I use it everyday before my moisturizer. It's very lightweight and I forget I even put in on throughout the day. I got this for free to try out.

I like the look results, the texture, the packaging, the hydration, etc. The only reason I don't give five stars is that even when you get that beautiful glow, it shows some glitter and I don't love it. Other than that, it's an amazing product.

Primers are not something I reach for in my already extensive makeup routine. My skin is dry and dehydrated, so I usually just stick to skincare. I was so pleasantly surprised that this primer actually made my skin look and feel so nice. It also sits beautifully under makeup.
super lightweight and the glimmery sheen is a nice touch. haven't seen much improvement in my overall skin texture though! been using for about a month now.

This is the first time I've tried this particular brand but I am 100% here for it! We'll start off with the packaging packaging itself is very simple but yet elegant at the same time. The serum / primer is absolutely beautiful! When you first dispense it it is very luminous and pearlescent and once you put it on your skin it absorbs quickly without leaving any type of greasy or oily finish and it still makes your skin look so lovely and fresh, regardless of age. I've used this both as a serum and as a primer and I almost don't even want to wear any type of makeup when I'm wearing this because it just brings out this youthful glow just as it is. Very beautiful!

This product blew all my expectations out of the water. I have to be picky on what products I use since I have an autoimmune disease which has made my skin age quicker. Full coverage products don't mesh well. THIS product however has made it into my permanent lineup. First off the packaging is very luxurious and quality feeling. The coloring of the product might throw you off and make you think you'll end up looking like Edward from Twilight..Do not panic.. It blends into one of the most beautiful,luminous, hydrating products you can put on your face. I used this many times before putting a review because I was shocked at how well it worked. I didn't have to use any foundation because it made my skin look AMAZING. The rest of my makeup stayed beautifully on my skin the entire day. For having mature like skin, this made me look and feel more youthful. It says use a few drops but I have a big face and just used the entire dropper. Well worth the price. Quality is unmatched. I can see this working well for so many different people. For those who like lightweight makeup and natural finishes to those that like a full glam I think this would be beautiful for everyone.

I received the Natasha Denona HY-GEN primer free from Bzzagent in exchange for my honest review. I'm loving this primer serum for the summer. It's giving me such a gorgeous glow that takes my makeup look to a different level. This dropper bottle serum has a subtle shimmer in it that looks so pretty on the skin when the light hits it. My makeup is long lasting and doesn't look dry or cakey. I love the added benefits of energizing and hydrating the skin while also keeping my makeup in place throughout the day. It's pretty pricey but a little goes a long way. I definitely recommend.

Super hydrating! I live how it makes my skin feel. I have oily skin and my cleanser makes it feel extra dry. But using this before apply my makeup makes my skin feel amazing. So lightweight. I would definitely continue buying this product

avis.titre: Great primer and highlighter in one!
avis.texte: I received this product for free from BzzAgent in exchange for my honest review. I have been using this product for the last ten days both as a primer and a highlighter. It has no noticeable scent and goes on smoothly. A little goes a long way and my makeup lasts all day! I also love the subtle glow this serum leaves on my skin. If you do not like the look of a highlighter this product is not for you.

i was so excited to get to try this product! i loved it, i felt so fancy & the results are great - but i did take a star off because its rather pricey and not something i could afford to include in my regular routine.

avis.titre: I def would buy it again
avis.texte: I normally don't use primers in my routine because my skin gets very dry and oily, however this prime hydrates me so much that I don't even worry about feeling dry. Give me a natural glow and a really hydrating finish that I wear it even tho when I'm not using foundation.

avis.titre: I would ABSOLUTELY love to buy this again
avis.texte: I have very dry skin and even after drying activities such as going to the pool this serum does wonders.

I absolutely love the Hy-GEN Primer. It's beautiful on the skin and leaves a glowy finish. It also absorbs into the skin leaving a soft silky feel. I cannot stop using it! Would recommend for all ages.

If you want to glow like Edward Cullen, this is for you. The product is shimmery, milky and hydrating. I love how light weight it is and how the scent is very minimal. I love that it dry on pretty fast and how it does last all day. MY skin looked so good, I got a bunch of compliments when I wore it to a family event. It really helped achieve that no make-up make-up look perfectly. I would totally recommend.

This primer has a white‑silver sparkly formula, and I didn't expect it to look glittery. It comes out thick and slightly sticky, but it is hydrating and does a good job creating an even layer on my skin, which makes sense since it's a primer. You do need to let it absorb before putting on foundation. If you want a little glow and shimmer while also hydrating your face, this is a product worth checking out. I docked a star because when first applying the primer, the scent smells of a very strong, clean bathroom scent and I prefer little to no scent in my skincare and makeup.

I'm not big on having glowy looking skin so this personally wasn't for me but for people that do love glowy skin I 1000% recommend this. It goes on smoothly. My skin felt great and my skin tint didn't pill when I put it on top of it.

I've really been enjoying this product because it works both as a serum and as a primer before foundation. It comes in a thick glass bottle with an eyedropper, and the formula itself is smooth, lightweight, and has a soft gold shimmer that gives my skin a natural glow. It applies easily, isn't too tacky, and leaves a nice hydrated sheen that sits well under makeup. There's also a very light, pleasant scent that doesn't linger or feel overpowering. My foundation goes on more evenly and wears better throughout the day, and my skin feels refreshed and hydrated. It's simple, effective, and does exactly what I want it to do.

avis.titre: I would gladly purchase this item!
avis.texte: I've been using this product and I'm really impressed with how lightweight and hydrating it feels on my skin. It gives a fresh, healthy glow without feeling greasy or heavy, and my makeup applies much smoother on top of it. My skin feels moisturized throughout the day, and it helps create a more radiant finish rather than a dry or cakey finish. What I like most is that it works both as a primer and as a skincare step. Overall, this a great option if you want a natural, dewy finish and smoother makeup application.
I've tried nearly every serum on the market and this one is my new favorite. It provides the perfect glow and keeps my makeup looking fresh all day. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: Great addition to my daily routine
avis.texte: This is a great hydrating primer. I have combination skim and this is a great addition. Keeps me hydrated but not oily. Creates a very healthy complexion.

i've been using the natasha denona hy-gen primer serum for a bit and it's actually really pretty on the skin it gives such a nice glowy, healthy look like your skin just looks fresh and hydrated right away. it feels super lightweight, blends in easily, and has a really nice scent which i didn't expect but liked i've been reaching for it more on days where i want that natural "no makeup" look because it really does make your skin look good on its own under foundation, it's not my absolute favorite primer ever, but it still works if you keep your base light. i just feel like it shines more as a glow booster than a full glam primer overall, if you're into that dewy, radiant skin look, this is definitely worth trying

I had the chance to try the Natasha Denona HY-GEN Energizing & Hydrating Primer Serum as a free sample, and it made a great first impression—especially for everyday makeup prep. The texture is lightweight and serum-like, and it sinks in quickly without feeling greasy. It gives my skin an instant boost of hydration and a soft, natural glow. I also noticed a slight grip after application, which helped my foundation go on smoother and look more even. This works really well for a natural, fresh-faced look. My skin looked more radiant and felt nicely prepped, especially on days when I kept my makeup minimal. The only reason I'm not giving it a full 5 stars is because it's not very pore-blurring or mattifying. If you have oily skin or need long wear, you may want something more targeted—but for hydration and glow, it does exactly what it claims.

I've been using this as a serum and not as a primer because I have very textured skin with large pores and try to avoid anything that makes my face shiny right before my makeup as that emphasizes everything on my face, which I don't want. If you're looking for glowy skin then definitely try this! Didn't breakout from this so that's a plus! Feels hydrating underneath my moisturizer too.

avis.titre: Perfect Shimmer for a Healthy Looking Glow
avis.texte: I've only been using this product for a few days, but so far I'm loving it! To preface, I have combination skin, but definitely more dry than oily. This product is not only hydrating but it doesn't feel heavy on my skin, making me feel oily. It initially leaves a slight sticky texture, which makes it perfect for its intent to act as a primer. It has shimmer, so you'll definitely feel like you're glowing. I haven't had any kind of reaction to it, and having sensitive skin, this is a huge win. My one issue with it is the scent. It has a pretty strong smell leaning towards floral, and I'm just not someone who enjoys scent in a product targeted for skincare. Once it settles into my skin, the smell goes away.

avis.titre: Hydrating Primer That Keeps Makeup Looking Fresh
avis.texte: This primer has become a staple in my routine. I love that it doubles as both a moisturizer and a primer, making it incredibly versatile. It feels smooth and comfortable on my skin while creating the perfect base for foundation. My makeup goes on more evenly, lasts longer throughout the day, and maintains a fresh, polished look. The added hydration is a great bonus, and my skin always feels soft and nourished when I use it.

I received this product for free for testing and review purposes. Absorbs quickly, but feels slightly tacky after application. The tackiness works great when using as a primer, but not as a standalone serum. Soft illumination when viewed from afar, but is very glittery when viewed up close. Leaves skin soft and plump, and layers well under makeup.

avis.titre: I am delighted with this product. I have dry, imperfect skin
avis.texte: I am delighted with this product. I have dry, imperfect skin—prone to breakouts and blackheads—so my makeup never really looked its best... until a week ago. I am absolutely thrilled with the hydration and softness it has brought to my skin; my makeup looks fantastic now!
Was gentle on sensitive skin and left a nice glowing finish. Worked well with Dior foundation.
I really like this pearlescent serum and the glowy finish it gave my skin. It smells really nice and it feels lightweight. I wore it by itself.

avis.titre: This can easily become a staple product
avis.texte: This primer serum really does work. The formula is very lightweight and it gives the skin a natural glow and not too overpowering. I've loved wearing under foundation and on its own on no makeup days. Would purchase this again.

I've been loving the Natasha Denona HY-GEN Primer Serum! It gives my skin a beautiful healthy glow without looking greasy, and the lightweight texture sinks in quickly. It keeps my makeup looking fresh and smooth throughout the day while adding an extra boost of hydration.

The first thing I love about this product is the sparkles in it. It is a creamy white color and leaves a very pretty iridecent finish. I have fairly dry skin that gets oily throughout the day and it was very hydrating while keeping the oil at bay. Compared to other products the finish is prettier. I didn't notice a huge difference in hydration or oil control compared to others. I did get a few pimples while using it which I am prone to anyway so I am not sure if this product directly cause it or if I would have gotten them anyway. It does have a faint fragrance that smells like vanilla to me. I would definitely recommend to friends and family.

I've tried many primers & this primer is the best by far. It's moisturizing, no separate moisturizer needed. It has a very light pearlescent sheen, like from within, not shiny or glittery at all like so many. It does not break me out & sinks right in, doesn't sit on your skin, doesn't pill, or makes foundation roll. it's definitely worth the splurge & a little goes a long way. Gorgeous glass bottle container too.
Used it for more than a week pearlike finish, guess gonna finish the bottle soon
I'm in love with this serum. It's lightweight, makes my face soft, smooth and hydrated.

I have to admit I was doubtful of what this product claimed it can do. I struggle with dermatitis and rosácea, so I am very picky with what I put on my face. I put a small amount on a section of my face in case it caused irritation, but it didn't. The next day, I put it all over my face, I like it. This product makes my skin glow and look hydrated. I would definitely recommend it as a primer as well as a serum.
Not really that good as a primer but it did feel very moisturizing as a serum. Will continue trying to see if it's effective

This primer serum really is hydrating. It absorbs into my skin almost instantly, and you can feel that your skin is actually hydrated and the feeling lasts! It has almost the sparkle to it and gives you this light glow, which is really pretty! The serum is lightweight and works really well under my makeup. I've been using it in the mornings because it makes my skin look refreshed. I was also pleasantly surprised that it does help manage my oil consistency throughout the day. I typically have really oily skin. I noticed it's not as bad when I am wearing this! Especially now that it is summertime!
I use this before makeup and it makes my skin look so smooth and glowy. Worth the price
The Hy-Gen ORIGINAL Primer Serum is amazing. It gave me a beautiful glow and it's very light. Not thick or sticky like some primers which cause me to breakout out. Will be telling all my friends.

avis.titre: A nice, hydrating 2 for 1 serum & primer
avis.texte: I received this product for free to test from BzzAgent and I'm so glad I did. I'm 41 and my skin has changed to extremely sensitive and dry. I've tried so many different skincare products to bring the youthful glow back but I always end up destroying my skin barrier when I introduce something new. I love that I was able to use this as a serum on its own as well as a primer under makeup. The serum gives a nice, highlighted glow rather than a greasy sheen like some other dewy products I've tried. I didn't have any burning or negative effects. When I used this as a primer, it made my makeup go on smoothly and my "every day" look stayed put. I haven't tried with heavier makeup so I'm unsure of longterm wear with that. Overall, it's a solid item to have in your arsenal, but whether there are better products at a cheaper price point is probably debatable.
Total game changer. I have combo-dry skin and this has hydrated my skin perfectly.

avis.titre: Better as serum than a primer
avis.texte: I received this product free- thanks Natasha Denona- in return for my honest review. I like the product however I think I like it better as a serum than a primer. I feel like it stays a little too sticky. It definitely has a glow to it.

I am an avid user when it comes to prepping products before make up application and I was drawn to this particular serum because not only does it add luminosity to the skin, but it claimed to be great for all skin tones and give a glow to the skin and it does absolutely that I was a little thrown off by the scent. It's too strong for myself, but my clients have not complained about it, but it does raise a concern that that might happen in the future. It's easy to use dries down quickly and allows the skin to breathe and have layers added on top easily definitely worth giving a try. Also the packaging is beautiful and stands out among the rest of my serum products.

I recently got this product and it makes a noticeable difference in regards to the look of my skin after application. It has a dewy, pearlescent finish and makes you feel moisturized all day. I haven't been wearing makeup this week and am very pleased with how my skin looks. It works great under makeup as well and makes a great primer. The only problem is I'm not sure how long it's going to last!

avis.titre: Glowy skin and clean girl aesthetic must
avis.texte: I have dry skin and did not like other primers i've used due to just leaving my skin sticky and feeling heavy once I put make up on, however this was super light weight and hydrating. My make up looked dewey but not greasy and helped blend my concealer and BB cream together nicely.

BzzAgent sent me this free sample through the BzzAgent sampling program. I just tried it for the first time and am so impressed. Dries quick and offers full coverage. Cant wait to use this as a primer in my every day routine now.

avis.titre: A versatile skin care and a primer in one absolute winner
avis.texte: Thank you BzzAgent for selecting me to try and review this product. I received this product for free to try for a few days and then rate it. I love this product. It made my face/ skin feel so soft, pampered with a little bit of shine/ glow. It hydrates my skin effectively. It is a vegan product and it is paraben, alcohol, gluten, silicon and talc free. It is very light weight, so I don't feel that I am wearing a serum. It is a wonderful product. I recommend this product as it is without the most harmful ingredients with can cause damage to our skin. I love this product and will continue using it/ buying it. It is perfect for me. Another excellent part of this is, I can use it as a primer and my skin glows with a subtle shine. It has two unique nutrient rich compounds. One is Hydroviton which immediately infuses the skin with continuous moisture for long hours and another is SymControl which balances the oil on skin and gives the glow/ shine. It has dermatologically tested blend of Mediterranean microalgae and anti- aging peptides to reduce hyperpigmentation and fine lines. I thinks it all plus+++ products with a lots of benefits for facial and aging skin.

This primer serum smoothed on so nicely! Its felt good and hydrating, made my skin look so full of life. There's a luminosity to it that makes your skin look perfect. My makeup applied so well on top. I even got compliments on my skin. I will use this with or without makeup!

I've used this primer serum a handful of times now, and i will say as a dry skin girly, i do enjoy the little glow it gives me, even on days when i don't wear makeup. It doesn't feel sticky, and I'm glad there is no heavy scent to it. I love the sleek packaging. i can see myself using this more often!

I absolutely love this product. It leaves the skin glowing. It leaves my skin, so I don't have to worry about breakouts after using it. This is one of my go to products and I always go grab it when I see it in store.

avis.titre: the best hy-gen Original Primer Serum
avis.texte: Thanks to Bzz Agent i tried HY-GEN ORIGINAL Primer Serum. I like it . This product is so nice. I noticed my skin has extra glow and radiance. The scent is so nice.

avis.titre: Works as a reliable primer under makeup
avis.texte: I just recently got this serum/primer. The consistency turned out to be more oily than I expected, but once it absorbs, it leaves a film that creates a great base for makeup. I have dry, sensitive skin, so this kind of texture is unusual for me. The shimmer has a lovely tone and creates a natural glow — you can see it in the swatch photo on my hand.

avis.titre: Gorgeous glow alone or as a primer!
avis.texte: I received this in exchange for my honest feedback and omg this is lovely! Wearing it alone is just as good! It leaves such a glow that is not just sparkly glitter but an actual glow without looking greasy. This melts right on and applies smoothly whether with a brush, sponge or fingers. My skin is so dry, but this makes layering makeup flawless! This is beautiful alone and as the base of your makeup!
I enjoy this product and it adds shine to my makeup look. It doesn't cause my makeup to pill and also makes my makeup last. The only downside is the price and it's super shiny for everyday use.

avis.titre: Cute and nice for the price
avis.texte: I think this primer works really well by itself and under foundation. It doesn't dry out my dry acne prone skin and does not aggravate it. I just dislike the fact they put mica in it. I don't think it's needed for the benefits it gives.

avis.titre: A Beautiful Glow, But Not Ideal Under Fundation
avis.texte: Natasha Denona sent me this free sample through the BzzAgent sampling program. The Natasha Denona HY-GEN Primer Serum is a pretty good primer.It gives the skin a radiant appearance and a glowing effect, while also providing good hydration. It has a lovely scent and spreads on pleasantly. On my combination skin, it works best when worn alone or underneath just a moisturizer. When worn under foundation, it sometimes settled into fine lines—slightly accentuating them—and, unfortunately, caused my foundation to wear off faster. Immediately after application, my skin was slightly red for a moment, but this redness faded quickly. Overall, it delivers a very fresh and healthy-looking skin effect.

I was looking for a new primer, and this one really does the trick! With other primers, I felt like my foundation was still slipping and sliding, however, with the HY-GEN primer, after a full day, none of my base has moved! It also leaves a glowing look to your base, so if you want to look radiant from the inside, this primer is for you. Another thing to note is that you can wear it as a serum or primer, but if you use it as a primer, make sure to let it set as well. I can't wait to use this every single day, and know that I'll look good no matter what with it on.

avis.titre: Primer that I use as a last step glow maker
avis.texte: This serum is just so good. I use it over a cc cream, and also the final step of my clean face routine. It glides over products and creates a beautiful glow, but gives you this baby skin look and feel. Don't miss this ladies of a certain age. It is like a halo for your skin!

avis.titre: Not really seeing glow or primed skin
avis.texte: I purchased this, looking for a glowing primer..I don't see a glow or experience a primed look with makeup.
I never wear foundation or much dramatic makeup but this is a game changer
gives you a nice "glow" and definitely see the improvement with my skin
Makeup comes off around nose and mouth halfway through the day with this primer
I love how my foundation looks on top if it. It's beautiful.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I love this product it makes my face feel so soft and glowing.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again; worth the money
avis.texte: I have purchased this product three times now and even though it is a bit pricey, it is worth the money. Very smooth and keeps foundation spread nicely.
This primer is so nice! It feels like a serum and is sooo glowy! One note tho, it is heavily scented (kind of like bubblegum) so if u dont like fragrance def keep that in mind!

The Hy-Gen Energizing & Hydrating Primer Serum is a total game-changer for my skincare and makeup routine! It feels incredibly lightweight and absorbs quickly, leaving my skin plump, hydrated, and glowing. The energizing effect is real—I look refreshed even on days when I'm running on little sleep. It creates the perfect canvas for makeup, helping it last all day while keeping my skin moisturized. If you're looking for a primer that combines skincare benefits with makeup prep, this is it. Highly recommend!
I used this as a primer initially, but have since preferred mixing it with my foundation of choice (haus labs) & I have never been happier with how my skin looks

I've used so many dewy, glory primers and this by far beats them all. My makeup goes on so smooth and retains a glow without being too shiny. I have very sensitive skin, but it doesn't bother, irritate or dry it out. It's very holographic in color and smells amazing. It reminds me of Olay body wash from way back in the late 90s. Such a clean scent. Best primer ever and worth the money

I love this Product. I use it more as a serum than a make-up primer, and put it under my face cream (Clinque 100H no sunscreen) and my face stays hydrated all day. Occasionally I'll layer Bobbi Brown Face Base on top of that combo if I'm wearing makeup. They all works so well together.

I bought this really hoping it would work for me. I do not have oily or dry skin. I used it twice and haven't used it again. I tried it once with Clinique tinted moisturizer. And once with my tarte foundation. I only used a tiny bit each time because a little goes along way. It did not look good on me. Both times trying the product I had to wash it off my face. I swear by the two-faced plump and prime. I am so glad they came out with one that works for me. It does look amazing on the lady in the photo on one of these reviews. It might just be my skin type. I don't think it would work for someone who has a skin type like mine that is neither Oily or dry

I am not someone who spends a lot of money on makeup, but I wanted a good primer since I often just wear primer and mascara rather than foundation and the works. I'm so glad I gave this a try. This is a liquid primer you apply with a dropper. I just rub it in with my hands and a few drops goes a long way since it is a bit glittery. Under makeup, it gives off the best dewy glow I've ever had. When worn alone, the glitter isnt too agressive - and it still gives off a nice glow for a no makeup day. This is now a staple for me. I bought a bottle in september and i still have about a month's worth left to last in december (so you definitely get a bang for your buck.) Definitely worth the money, if you love a subtle glow you will love this

I have repurchased this. I am 59, with dry skin. I love the subtle scent and the feel of this primer. I use this but mixing a few drops with my Dior Backstage foundation and it is so beautiful on the skin. I definitely recommend!
I really like this primer. Its make my skin look dewey without being greasey or sticky. Wears well under my foundation. No pilling issues and has not caused any break outs on my sensitive skin.
I got a tester and it was lovely just wished it was fragrance free too!! Please make a fragrance free version!

I can't even express how great this makes my skin look. I bought this on a whim because I've only ever tried Natasha's eyeshadows. I was pleasantly surprised at how far this exceeded my expectations. It's now my favorite primer!
I use this everyday and it feels amazing. It makes putting on makeup over it easy and really does a great job prepping my skin.

I have very sensitive skin with rosacea and it's hard for me to find products that don't irritate my skin. This primer is pure magic. It is so soothing and beautiful. My makeup looks flawless and poreless and it stays on all day thanks to this amazing primer. This is the best primer I have ever tried and trust I tried ALOT!

avis.titre: Right choice, wants to buy again n again.
avis.texte: Amazing glow and my makeup comes out fantastic after using this primer serum. Sometimes I just have this serum on and just a little touch of blush nothing else and my face looks amazingly glowing.
Gives my skin a pretty glow without looking shiny, perfect base for my makeup.
Such an amazing, hydrating primer. The way it makes your skin look is amazing. Very pretty!

I have very dry skin, and I usually have to layer a facial oil underneath my primer in the winter. Not with this! This keeps my face hydrated and smooth all day, no patchiness and I feel confident wearing it under all my foundations! Highly recommend!
It has sparkiles in it bot my thing i dont wear makeup because it messes up your face

I've tried many high end primers & this primer by NATASHA DENONA is the best by far. It's moisturizing, no separate moisturizer needed, which is great in the hot & humid climate where I live. It has a very light pearlescent sheen, like from within, not shiny or glittery at all like so many. It does not break me out & sinks right in, doesn't sit on your skin, doesn't pill, or makes foundation roll. I also use it to perfect the color for my skin tone with the two high end foundation shades I mix because I can never find a foundation shade that's just right. I would recommend this primer by NATASHA DENONA very highly, it's definitely worth the splurge & a little goes a long way. Gorgeous glass bottle container too. I've purchased several NATASHA DENONA products now & they all are divine, especially the beautiful & buttery eyeshadow palettes. I'm switching from my 2 luxury brands I've been using for many years to all NATASHA DENONA now, hopefully the product line will increase in the coming years. 10 stars!!!

I've used this as both a serum before mousturizer and as a makeup primer prior to makeup application. It works amazing as either one! This makes your skin feel incredible and the glow is superb! It's not sticky or greasy and still acheives that amazing ethereal glow that makes skin look SO HEALTHY! I absolutely love this stuff. Works great with ND foundation and concealers, too.

I bought it to use without foundation, just to create a trendy wet glow on certain parts of the face. However, unfortunately, as it absorbs and dries, it leaves only small sparkles. They are beautiful, but if you apply the serum in its pure form, these sparkles can leave streaks on the face. So, it's best to use it with foundation or tint.

avis.titre: This is what was missing from my routine
avis.texte: This is the perfect primer for my combination skin. I am almost 40 and my skin is changing. I have had such a hard time finding primers that work for me. This makes all of my foundations look amazing and it looks better as the day goes on. It controls my oil but keeps a radiant finish. It is 100% worth the money!
I have more mature skin and it really likes this primer. Gives a bit of a glow and has great ingredients. Seems to help my foundation last longer. My skin is normal to dry for reference.

i was having such a hard time with cakeyness around my eyebrows and chin and makeup not sitting right and i came to the conclusion it was my primer so i set out to find a new one and i finally settled on this one and let me tell you i havent found ANYTHING better its so beautiful and leaves my skin looking perfect i use it along with my hourglass powder and its a great combo
